confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates use current New Orleans cost indexes; cocktail prices are around $13–14 in local indexes, and wine is estimated from local glass-menu examples. Hostel rates vary by season, and the private-room estimate is less certain because booking pages show low starting prices with an unclear per-person basis. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates, not checks of live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink anchors use New Orleans price data directly. Hotel anchors reflect a large U.S. leisure-city market; no direct comparable city was used.
